limitations: Observer TF samples are about 5 Hz wall time, not every mission callback; crossing time is bounded by recorded samples.
Latest odometry records are not interpolated to the TF sample stamp; each source timestamp and receipt age is retained.
Native trajectories are independent motion evidence and are not transformed into map coordinates here.
Map->odom correction and controller stop timing explain observed current-map gate failure; this is not a replay of internal Nav2 GoalChecker variables.
No frame bag was read; failure occurred before a goal-6 inspection_started event, so no claim about goal-6 frame acceptance is made.
The goal-5 satisfied ledger in goal-6 failure is a separate attribution bug; this analysis does not count it as goal-6 evidence.
